The [[Delvin Constructs/Legends|Delvin Constructs]] Model '''Com C-52''' was a command center building used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on locations where no structures to convert into base of operations were available.
Produced by [[Delvin Constructs/Legends|Delvin Constructs]], it was cheap and fast to construct, but was often left behind during the evacuation, which resulted in many of them being occupied by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
